issues_detected.description: The record gives release history but no update cadence or maintenance policy.
issues_detected.recommendation: State the planned update frequency or event-driven update policy, including an explicit statement if no further updates are planned.

issues_detected.description: Broad intended applications and acquisition exercises do not define specific primary research questions, outcomes, or modeling tasks for this release.
issues_detected.recommendation: Specify supported research questions or analytical tasks, including the population and outcome or target being studied, without treating recording exercises as research objectives.

issues_detected.description: The project homepage and processing references do not provide a complete standards and imputation account. Omitted feature files do not establish whether other released values were imputed.
issues_detected.recommendation: Link applicable technical standards and protocol documentation, and explicitly describe imputation by data type or state that it was not used.

issues_detected.description: The record does not analyze how recruitment, eligibility, acquisition differences, or incomplete feature coverage limit use or generalization.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add an explicit limitations assessment grounded in the documented cohort and acquisition characteristics, stating implications for downstream analyses.

issues_detected.description: No categorized dataset-bias or fairness assessment is provided.
issues_detected.recommendation: Document supported bias categories, affected populations or analyses, and mitigation recommendations rather than leaving readers to infer them from eligibility criteria.

issues_detected.description: The record describes privacy controls but does not explicitly identify retained sensitive content or provide content warnings for released pediatric health information.
issues_detected.recommendation: Identify the sensitive data categories retained in the release and document applicable user-facing warnings.

issues_detected.description: Research ethics approval is documented, but anticipated downstream social impacts and mitigations are not analyzed.
issues_detected.recommendation: Assess foreseeable benefits and harms of downstream pediatric screening and voice analysis, including supported mitigations and limits on interpretation.

semantic_insights: The record explicitly distinguishes the latest-version DOI from the version 1.1.0 DOI, avoiding a false identifier-conflict finding.
Pediatric ethics approval and consent are documented without importing USF adult-protocol provisions into the Canadian pediatric cohort.
The 23,533-recording total and 23,532-record sparc_* coverage are disclosed at different levels and are not treated as contradictory participant counts.
Feature-only PhysioNet distribution is consistently distinguished from separately controlled raw-audio access.
Processing software satisfies the processing-role threshold: b2aiprep and the named feature-extraction tools are tied directly to released data transformations.
Intermediate BIDS conversion is expressly distinguished from release layout and therefore does not establish release-level conformance.
Release changes, hosting, and quality issues are supported by substantive evidence at their actual record locations even where dedicated fields are absent.
The funding program is inferred from the populated funders description, not from the filename or invocation identity.
